section: Shure products at AVI-SPL: IntelliMix Bar Pro Kit, Microflex Ecosystem, MXW neXt, MXA902 and ShureCloud
body:
The Shure product range presented on AVI-SPL's Shure page, from an all-in-one video bar to networked audio components and cloud management. Use it to match a Shure product to a room type or requirement.

**IntelliMix Bar Pro Kit (All-in-one Video Conference Bar)**

- An Android based all-in-one video conference bar, Microsoft Teams Certified for medium to large collaboration spaces.
- IntelliMix Processing gives AI-enhanced audio free of echo, noise and reverb, to cut down distraction while meetings are active.
- AI-powered 4K cameras that cover a wide angle of 135 degrees, plus telephoto lenses, to capture everyone in the room.
- Android security practices that build on Microsoft Device Ecosystem Platform (MDEP).
- The IntelliMix Bar Pro puts patented Shure array microphones and high output stereo loudspeakers into a single device.

**Microflex Ecosystem**

- Networked audio for demanding spaces, covering microphones, DSPs and loudspeakers that can be combined to suit the room.

**MXW neXt (2/4/8 channel)**

- An all-in-one wireless audio solution for hybrid classrooms, training rooms and flexible meeting spaces, described as simple to set up and scalable.

**IntelliMix Room Kits**

- Conferencing kits for Microsoft Teams Rooms or Zoom Room, for small to large spaces, described as simple and secure.

**Networked Loudspeakers**

- Microflex loudspeakers offer speech-focused sound, flexible speakers and customization.
- The Microflex Ecosystem provides secure, unified management.
- Existing setups can be upgraded with the MXN-AMP PoE+ amplifier.

**MXA902 Ceiling Array + Loudspeaker**

- Automatic Coverage technology captures audio precisely without setup.
- Its array architecture improves directional pickup and natural speech.
- Positioned for conferencing, camera tracking, voice lift and sound reinforcement.

**ShureCloud**

- Audio management with remote management, real-time monitoring and streamlined updates, intended to optimize performance and minimize downtime for organizations of any size.

**When to use this**

For questions about which Shure device suits a medium or large Teams room, a flexible training space or a ceiling-microphone room, and how Shure devices are managed remotely.

**Not stated in this source**: Zoom certification for the IntelliMix Bar Pro Kit, room dimensions, license requirements and prices.
